steps.code:
# Get all liked songs to know which songs are liked
liked_songs = []
page_index = 0
page_limit = 20
while True:
    page = apis.spotify.show_liked_songs(access_token=access_token, page_index=page_index, page_limit=page_limit)
    if not page or len(page) == 0:
        break
    liked_songs.extend(page)
    if len(page) < page_limit:
        break
    page_index += 1

liked_song_ids = set(song['song_id'] for song in liked_songs)
print(f"Total liked songs: {len(liked_song_ids)}")
print(liked_song_ids)

steps.code:
# Loop: go to previous song until we find a liked song
current_song_id = current['song_id']
while current_song_id not in liked_song_ids:
    # Go to previous song
    prev_result = apis.spotify.previous_song(access_token=access_token)
    print("Previous song result:", prev_result)
    # Get the new current song
    current = apis.spotify.show_current_song(access_token=access_token)
    current_song_id = current['song_id']
    print("Now at song:", current_song_id, current.get('title'))

# Found a liked song
print("Reached liked song:", current_song_id, current.get('title'))
apis.supervisor.complete_task(answer=current_song_id)
